item: The os-patch guard reads os.path, aliases, keyword and multiple forms, assignments and every file under tests/
summary: Closes the blind spots #1602 listed: os.path and posixpath/ntpath/genericpath, import aliases, target= keywords, patch.multiple, assignments, and files outside tests/test_*.py. New scope_os_path helper; the one os.path site (vacuum preflight) converted. Measured on main: the wider guard newly flags two places in 1,535 files, the vacuum site (fixed) and tests/torture_helper.py (a child process that kills itself at the swap, allowlisted). A mutant per blind spot turns a test red.
